annotator: read by eye from the delivered photograph, one pass per image
note: What is PRINTED ON THE PANEL IN THIS FRAME, not what the product is known to declare elsewhere. A declaration on another face of the pack is absent here, because the frame is what the extractor is given. A field mapped to null is printed but its value is not legible in this frame, or the pack prints a cross-reference ('See on Crimp') instead of a value. A list means the panel carries more than one distinct value for that field.
field_mapping: Rule 6(1)(a)'s name-and-address is annotated by the label actually printed: 'Manufactured by' / 'Marketed by' / 'Mktd. by' / 'Mfg. by' -> manufacturer; 'Packed by' -> packer; 'Imported by' -> importer. This matches how vision/classify/regex_tier.py resolves the same labels, so a score against these labels measures extraction rather than a disagreement about vocabulary.
